4 امجّ , (S, K,) and, by poetic licence, أَمْجَجَ, (TA,) inf. n. إِمْجَاجٌ, (As,) He (a horse) ran violently: (TA:) or he (a horse) began to perform the act of running, before it (his run, As) was vehement, or ardent. (قَبْلَ أَنْ يَضْطَرِمَ). (As, S, K.) ―
-b2- He (a man) went, or went forth journeying, through (فى) countries. (S, K.) ―
-b3- He went away, or departed, to (إِلى) a country or town. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
